This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. In [[3950 BBY]] he was chosen to be part of [[Murtog]]'s handpicked team that [[Operation supernova|ambushed]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the brief skirmish.

==Biography==
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. In [[3950 BBY]] he was handpicked by [[Murtog]]'s to be part of a team that [[Operation supernova|ambushed]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the brief skirmish.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The male soldier first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]]. Note the article doesn't reflect how soldier died, since the novel doesn't specify if Murtog or the unidentified soldier was the one Surik used [[Shiak]] on or if he was set on [[Fire/Legends|fire]] by [[T3-M4]].
